server_name.title: Server name
server_name.description: Name shown in the server list and lobby.

server_message.title: Server message
server_message.description: Message displayed to players in the lobby.

server_password.title: Join password
server_password.description: Password required to join; leave empty to allow joining without a password.

admin_entries.title: Administrator accounts
admin_entries.description: Managed in Player management and written to Data/clientpermissions.xml. Each line accepts a Steam2, Steam3 or SteamID64 account, optionally followed by a comma and display name; listed accounts receive full permissions.

public_server.title: Public server listing
public_server.description: Advertise the server publicly. Private servers do not enable the Steam query endpoint.

voice_chat_enabled.title: Voice chat
voice_chat_enabled.description: Allow players to use the game's voice chat.

allow_file_transfers.title: Submarine file transfers
allow_file_transfers.description: Allow the server to send submarine files to connecting players.

tick_rate.title: Server tick rate (Hz)
tick_rate.description: Server simulation updates per second, from 1 to 60.

randomize_seed.title: Randomize level seed
randomize_seed.description: Choose a new random level seed when starting a round.

karma_enabled.title: Karma system
karma_enabled.description: Track harmful player behavior and apply the selected karma rules.

use_respawn_shuttle.title: Respawn shuttle
use_respawn_shuttle.description: Respawn players in a shuttle; when disabled, respawn them aboard the main submarine.

respawn_interval.title: Respawn countdown (seconds)
respawn_interval.description: Delay before respawning eligible players once the minimum respawn ratio is met.

auto_restart.title: Automatically start next round
auto_restart.description: Start a new round after the lobby countdown. This does not restart a crashed server process.

auto_restart_interval.title: Next-round countdown (seconds)
auto_restart_interval.description: Lobby delay before automatically starting the next round.

start_when_clients_ready.title: Start when players are ready
start_when_clients_ready.description: Start the round when the configured proportion of players marks itself ready.

allow_vote_kick.title: Vote to kick players
allow_vote_kick.description: Allow players to initiate votes to remove another player.

allow_end_voting.title: Vote to end the round
allow_end_voting.description: Allow players to vote to end the current round.

ban_after_wrong_password.title: Ban repeated password failures
ban_after_wrong_password.description: Automatically ban connections that exceed the allowed number of incorrect password attempts.

max_password_retries_before_ban.title: Incorrect password attempt limit
max_password_retries_before_ban.description: Number of incorrect join-password attempts allowed before automatic banning.

auto_ban_time.title: Automatic ban duration (seconds)
auto_ban_time.description: Duration of automatic bans for incorrect passwords and other server-enforced bans.

mod_workshop_ids.title: Workshop content IDs
mod_workshop_ids.description: Managed in Mods. List one Workshop item ID per line; installed packages are enabled for this instance.

extra_launch_args.title: Additional launch arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Append one complete process argument per line to DedicatedServer startup.

enable_upnp.title: UPnP port mapping
enable_upnp.description: Ask a compatible router to create the server's port mappings automatically.

hidden_subs.title: Hidden submarines
hidden_subs.description: Comma-separated submarine names to omit from the lobby selection list.

allowed_random_mission_types.title: Random mission pool
allowed_random_mission_types.description: Comma-separated mission type identifiers eligible for random selection; use installed content identifiers.

allowed_client_name_chars.title: Allowed player-name characters
allowed_client_name_chars.description: Comma-separated decimal Unicode code-point ranges, such as 65-90. Names containing other characters are rejected.

max_lag_compensation.title: Weapon lag compensation (ms)
max_lag_compensation.description: Maximum time the server rewinds hit detection for delayed weapon input, from 0 to 500 milliseconds.

require_authentication.title: Require account authentication
require_authentication.description: Verify joining clients through Steam or Epic ownership authentication; disabling this removes that account check.

max_transport_time.title: Respawn shuttle duration (seconds)
max_transport_time.description: Time available to reach the main submarine before the respawn shuttle leaves the level; 0 removes the time limit.

min_respawn_ratio.title: Minimum respawn ratio
min_respawn_ratio.description: Fraction of dead or spectating players required to dispatch a respawn; 0.2 means 20%.

skill_loss_percentage_on_death.title: Skill loss on death (%)
skill_loss_percentage_on_death.description: Percentage by which skills move toward the job's initial levels after death.

skill_loss_percentage_on_immediate_respa.title: Additional immediate-respawn skill loss (%)
skill_loss_percentage_on_immediate_respa.description: Additional skill loss for choosing to respawn during the round, on top of the death penalty.

replace_cost_percentage.title: Replacement character cost (%)
replace_cost_percentage.description: Cost multiplier for replacing a permanently dead character; 100 is normal cost and 0 makes replacements free.

allow_bot_takeover_on_permadeath.title: Take over bots after permanent death
allow_bot_takeover_on_permadeath.description: Allow a player whose character died permanently to control a crew bot.

ironman_mode.title: Ironman campaign
ironman_mode.description: With Permadeath respawning, a dead player can only spectate and cannot obtain a replacement character.

pvp_team_selection_mode.title: Team assignment
pvp_team_selection_mode.description: Use player team preferences for assignment, or let players explicitly choose their team.

pvp_auto_balance_threshold.title: Team size difference limit
pvp_auto_balance_threshold.description: Maximum allowed difference between team sizes when players choose teams.

start_when_clients_ready_ratio.title: Ready-player ratio
start_when_clients_ready_ratio.description: Fraction of players that must be ready to start automatically; 0.8 means 80%.

pvp_stun_resist.title: PvP stun resistance
pvp_stun_resist.description: Fraction of stun effects prevented for human characters in PvP; 0.5 means 50% resistance.

pvp_spawn_monsters.title: Spawn monsters in PvP
pvp_spawn_monsters.description: Include monsters in generated PvP levels.

pvp_spawn_wrecks.title: Spawn wrecks in PvP
pvp_spawn_wrecks.description: Include submarine wrecks in generated PvP levels.

biome.title: Biome
biome.description: Biome identifier for level generation; Random lets the game choose.

selected_outpost_name.title: Outpost
selected_outpost_name.description: Outpost selection identifier; Random lets the game choose.

allow_spectating.title: Allow spectating
allow_spectating.description: Allow connected players to watch without controlling a character.

allow_afk.title: Allow away status
allow_afk.description: Allow players to mark themselves away; away players are excluded from active participation and their inactivity timer pauses.

save_server_logs.title: Write server logs
save_server_logs.description: Save the game's server activity log to disk.

allow_mod_downloads.title: Allow client Mod downloads
allow_mod_downloads.description: Allow joining clients to download the server's enabled content packages.

allow_remote_campaign_interactions.title: Remote campaign interactions
allow_remote_campaign_interactions.description: Allow campaign interactions such as shops without moving the character to the relevant NPC.

play_style.title: Play style
play_style.description: Server-list category describing the intended play style; it does not select a game mode.

los_mode.title: Line-of-sight visibility
los_mode.description: Choose unrestricted vision, dim static scenery through walls, or fully opaque obstruction.

show_enemy_health_bars.title: Enemy health bars
show_enemy_health_bars.description: Show all enemy health bars, only boss health bars, or none.

lines_per_log_file.title: Lines per log file
lines_per_log_file.description: Maximum number of log lines before the game starts another log file.

respawn_mode.title: Respawn mode
respawn_mode.description: Choose no respawning, mid-round respawning, between-round respawning, or permanent character death.

bot_count.title: Crew bot count
bot_count.description: Number of bots to add in Normal mode, or the target crew size in Fill mode.

max_bot_count.title: Crew bot limit
max_bot_count.description: Maximum number of crew bots allowed by the server.

bot_spawn_mode.title: Bot population mode
bot_spawn_mode.description: Normal adds the configured bot count; Fill uses bots to fill the crew target.

disable_bot_conversations.title: Disable bot conversations
disable_bot_conversations.description: Suppress ambient conversations between crew bots.

selected_level_difficulty.title: Level difficulty
selected_level_difficulty.description: Difficulty used for a selected non-campaign level, from 0 to 100.

allow_disguises.title: Allow disguises
allow_disguises.description: Allow characters to conceal or impersonate their identity using disguise items.

allow_rewiring.title: Allow rewiring
allow_rewiring.description: Allow players to change device wiring during play.

allow_immediate_item_delivery.title: Immediate item delivery
allow_immediate_item_delivery.description: Allow purchased campaign items to be delivered immediately.

lock_all_default_wires.title: Lock original wiring
lock_all_default_wires.description: Prevent players from removing the submarine's original wires.

allow_linking_wifi_to_chat.title: Link Wi-Fi components to chat
allow_linking_wifi_to_chat.description: Allow Wi-Fi components to exchange signals with the chat system.

allow_friendly_fire.title: Friendly fire
allow_friendly_fire.description: Allow damage between characters on the same team.

allow_drag_and_drop_give.title: Give items by drag and drop
allow_drag_and_drop_give.description: Allow giving another character an item by dragging it onto them.

killable_npcs.title: Killable NPCs
killable_npcs.description: Allow non-player characters to be killed.

enable_dos_protection.title: Network abuse protection
enable_dos_protection.description: Enable the game's protection against excessive network traffic.

max_packet_amount.title: Client message limit (per minute)
max_packet_amount.description: Kick clients exceeding this message rate. A value at or below 1200 disables the limit; values below 3500 can disconnect normal clients.

selected_submarine.title: Selected submarine
selected_submarine.description: Name of an installed submarine to select in the lobby.

selected_shuttle.title: Selected respawn shuttle
selected_shuttle.description: Name of an installed shuttle to use for respawning.

traitor_probability.title: Traitor event probability
traitor_probability.description: Probability of traitor events, from 0 to 1; 0 disables them and 1 means 100%.

traitor_danger_level.title: Traitor danger level
traitor_danger_level.description: Highest traitor-event danger level, from 1 to 3.

traitors_min_player_count.title: Minimum players for traitors
traitors_min_player_count.description: Minimum connected players required before traitor events can occur.

min_percentage_of_players_for_traitor_ac.title: Traitor accusation threshold (%)
min_percentage_of_players_for_traitor_ac.description: Percentage of players required to support a traitor accusation.

language.title: Server language
language.description: Language advertised for this server, using a game language identifier such as English.

sub_selection_mode.title: Submarine selection
sub_selection_mode.description: Let an administrator select the submarine, choose randomly, or use a player vote.

mode_selection_mode.title: Game mode selection
mode_selection_mode.description: Let an administrator select the mode, choose randomly, or use a player vote.

end_vote_required_ratio.title: End-round vote ratio
end_vote_required_ratio.description: Fraction of players needed to pass an end-round vote; 0.6 means 60%.

vote_required_ratio.title: General vote ratio
vote_required_ratio.description: Required vote fraction for supported lobby and campaign voting; 0.6 means 60%.

vote_timeout.title: Vote timeout (seconds)
vote_timeout.description: Time allowed to complete a timed vote.

kick_vote_required_ratio.title: Kick vote ratio
kick_vote_required_ratio.description: Fraction of eligible players required to pass a kick vote; 0.6 means 60%.

disallow_kick_vote_time.title: New-player voting delay (seconds)
disallow_kick_vote_time.description: Time after joining before a player is counted among eligible kick voters.

kill_disconnected_time.title: Disconnected character death delay (seconds)
kill_disconnected_time.description: Time a disconnected character remains before being removed through brain death in ordinary respawn modes.

despawn_disconnected_permadeath_time.title: Permadeath disconnect removal delay (seconds)
despawn_disconnected_permadeath_time.description: Time a disconnected character remains vulnerable before removal in Permadeath mode.

kick_afk_time.title: Inactivity kick delay (seconds)
kick_afk_time.description: Time without player input before kicking. Allowed away status pauses this timer; administrator exemptions follow the game.

minimum_mid_round_sync_timeout.title: Mid-round sync grace period (seconds)
minimum_mid_round_sync_timeout.description: Minimum time given to a client joining an ongoing round to synchronize its state.

round_start_sync_duration.title: Round-start sync timeout (seconds)
round_start_sync_duration.description: Time allowed for clients to synchronize after the round starts before disconnecting them.

event_removal_time.title: Delivered event retention (seconds)
event_removal_time.description: Retain events for this duration after all currently synchronized clients have received them.

old_received_event_kick_time.title: Partially delivered event timeout (seconds)
old_received_event_kick_time.description: Disconnect a client that still lacks an event after it has already been delivered to another client for this duration.

old_event_kick_time.title: Undelivered event timeout (seconds)
old_event_kick_time.description: Disconnect a client that has not received an event within this duration.

timeout_threshold_not_in_game.title: Lobby connection timeout (seconds)
timeout_threshold_not_in_game.description: Disconnect after this period without messages while in the lobby or loading screen.

timeout_threshold_in_game.title: In-round connection timeout (seconds)
timeout_threshold_in_game.description: Disconnect after this period without messages during an active round.

karma_preset.title: Karma preset
karma_preset.description: Name of a karma rule preset available in the server's karma configuration.

game_mode_identifier.title: Game mode
game_mode_identifier.description: Installed game-mode identifier, for example sandbox, mission, pvp or multiplayercampaign.

mission_types.title: Selected mission types
mission_types.description: Comma-separated mission type identifiers selected for the round.

max_auto_ban_time.title: Automatic ban duration limit (seconds)
max_auto_ban_time.description: Upper duration offered by the game's automatic-ban settings control.

looted_money_destination.title: Looted money destination
looted_money_destination.description: Send looted money to the shared bank or the looting character's wallet.

maximum_money_transfer_request.title: Money transfer request limit
maximum_money_transfer_request.description: Largest amount a player can request in one campaign money transfer.

new_campaign_default_salary.title: New-campaign salary share (%)
new_campaign_default_salary.description: Default percentage share used for crew salaries when creating a campaign.

track_opponent_in_pvp.title: Show opposing submarine on sonar
track_opponent_in_pvp.description: Show the opposing team's submarine on sonar in PvP.

disembark_point_allowance.title: Starting perk points
disembark_point_allowance.description: Points available for selecting starting perks in PvP, mission and sandbox modes.

selected_coalition_perks.title: Coalition starting perks
selected_coalition_perks.description: Semicolon-separated identifiers of selected Coalition perks, within the perk point allowance.

win_score_pvp.title: PvP winning score
win_score_pvp.description: Score needed to win PvP missions that use a scoring system.

selected_separatists_perks.title: Separatist starting perks
selected_separatists_perks.description: Semicolon-separated identifiers of selected Separatist perks, within the perk point allowance.

disabled_monsters.title: Disabled monster species
disabled_monsters.description: Comma-separated creature identifiers excluded from monster spawning.

campaign_preset_name.title: Campaign preset name
campaign_preset_name.description: Name recorded for the campaign settings preset; individual values below remain explicit settings.

campaign_tutorial_enabled.title: Campaign tutorial
campaign_tutorial_enabled.description: Enable tutorial guidance when starting the campaign.

campaign_radiation_enabled.title: Jovian radiation
campaign_radiation_enabled.description: Enable the radiation front that advances across the campaign map.

campaign_max_mission_count.title: Missions per departure
campaign_max_mission_count.description: Base number of missions selectable for one departure, from 1 to 10; talents may add more.

campaign_world_hostility.title: World hostility
campaign_world_hostility.description: Campaign difficulty tier affecting level difficulty and event pressure.

campaign_start_item_set.title: Starting supply set
campaign_start_item_set.description: Identifier of an installed starting-item set, such as normal.

campaign_starting_balance_amount.title: Starting funds
campaign_starting_balance_amount.description: Select the initial campaign bank-balance tier defined by the campaign presets.

campaign_crew_vitality_multiplier.title: Crew vitality multiplier
campaign_crew_vitality_multiplier.description: Multiply the vitality of crew characters; 1 keeps the normal value.

campaign_non_crew_vitality_multiplier.title: Non-crew vitality multiplier
campaign_non_crew_vitality_multiplier.description: Multiply the vitality of characters outside the crew; 1 keeps the normal value.

campaign_oxygen_multiplier.title: Oxygen tank capacity multiplier
campaign_oxygen_multiplier.description: Multiply the capacity of oxygen-source tanks, rather than oxygen consumption.

campaign_fuel_multiplier.title: Reactor fuel duration multiplier
campaign_fuel_multiplier.description: Multiply how long reactor fuel lasts; higher values extend fuel duration.

campaign_mission_reward_multiplier.title: Mission money reward multiplier
campaign_mission_reward_multiplier.description: Multiply money earned from completing campaign missions.

campaign_experience_reward_multiplier.title: Experience reward multiplier
campaign_experience_reward_multiplier.description: Multiply experience rewards earned by campaign characters.

campaign_repair_fail_multiplier.title: Failed-repair damage multiplier
campaign_repair_fail_multiplier.description: Multiply damage suffered when a repair attempt fails.

campaign_show_husk_warning.title: Early husk infection warning
campaign_show_husk_warning.description: Warn about a husk infection before it becomes visible in the health interface.

campaign_patdown_probability.title: Security search frequency
campaign_patdown_probability.description: Select how frequently outpost security performs searches, or disable them.
